headword: {情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}
reading: じょうほうしゅうしゅう

definitions.explanation: The systematic act of seeking out and collecting information on a topic. Used broadly in everyday, business, academic, and military/intelligence contexts.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
ネットで{情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}をする。
{転職|てんしょく}{前|まえ}に{徹底的|てっていてき}な{情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: I conducted thorough information gathering before changing jobs.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{時|じ}には{正確|せいかく}な{情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}が{命|いのち}を{守|まも}る。
examples.english: During a disaster, accurate information gathering saves lives.

notes:
Compound of {情報|じょうほう} (information) + {収集|しゅうしゅう} (collection/gathering). Functions as a noun and can take する to become a verb ({情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}する). Very common in business, journalism, research, and everyday decision-making contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out information gathering
- {情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}{能力|のうりょく}: information-gathering ability
- {情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}{活動|かつどう}: intelligence-gathering activities
- {事前|じぜん}の{情報|じょうほう}{収集|しゅうしゅう}: advance information gathering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調査|ちょうさ}: investigation; survey — more formal and structured, often with a specific methodology
- {取材|しゅざい}: news gathering; coverage — specifically for journalism
- リサーチ: research — loanword used casually, especially in business
